description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome back to the student lettings market this beautifully presented three-bedroom student property on the popular Bayswater Road, in the heart of West Jesmond.

Finished to a high standard throughout, this homely ground-floor flat offers three spacious double bedrooms, a large central bathroom and a modern open-plan kitchen and living area, creating the perfect space for both relaxing and socialising.

The property also benefits from a south-facing rear yard, ideal for enjoying the warmer months. Ideally located just a short walk from West Jesmond Metro Station, the property offers excellent transport links alongside easy access to the shops, cafés and bars of Osborne Road. Combining stylish interiors with a sought-after student location, this property is an excellent choice for students looking to make the most of everything Jesmond has to offer.

Contact My Property Box today to arrange your viewing!
